issues.description: User is being redirected to /auth instead of reaching /design/step-3. The style quiz content is completely absent. The URL shows ?next=%2Fdesign%2Fstep-3, meaning the auth middleware is blocking access to step-3 and redirecting unauthenticated users to login.
issues.element: Entire page - showing auth instead of step-3 style quiz
issues.root_cause: The middleware or route protection logic is requiring authentication for /design/step-3. Additionally, there are two 500 errors in the console logs which suggest the step-3 page itself has a server error. The 500 errors on the server side may be causing the redirect to auth, or the middleware is intentionally protecting /design routes. The step-3 page likely has a runtime error (500) that needs to be investigated.

issues.description: Two 500 Internal Server Error responses in console logs, likely from the /design/step-3 route or an API call it makes. This server error may be preventing proper rendering of step-3.
issues.element: Server error on step-3 page load
issues.root_cause: apps/web/app/design/step-3/page.tsx likely has a server-side rendering error, possibly from an unhandled async operation, missing environment variable, or database call failure.
